name: Sequential Thinking (reference server)
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C7, C9, C10; partly meets C8.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The npm record for @modelcontextprotocol/server-sequential-thinking@2.1.1 names the repository `git+https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers.git` and carries a provenance attestation (`dist.attestations`).

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub shows a security policy for the repository (`SECURITY.md` in the repository), and it describes how to report a vulnerability.

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is not archived and the package is not marked deprecated. Latest release 2.1.1 is dated 2026-11-04; the newest commit on `main` is dated 2026-11-11; GitHub reports the last push on 2026-11-12.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: No advisory is published in the repository's advisory list for @modelcontextprotocol/server-sequential-thinking.

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: The single tool records reasoning steps; no write, delete or execute capability on external resources is documented. Quoted: “Facilitates a detailed, step-by-step thinking process for problem-solving and analysis.”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: The documented setup takes no credential. Searched `src/sequentialthinking/README.md` for: API_KEY, _TOKEN\b, password.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: The README contains no reference to telemetry or usage collection, and the documented function contacts only the service the user configures. Searched `src/sequentialthinking/README.md` for: telemetry, usage statistics, usage stats, we collect, data collection, opt-out, posthog.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`package-lock.json`) is committed. No Dependabot or Renovate configuration file exists at the paths listed in the methodology.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: The documented tool returns only values the server computes from the client's own input. Quoted: “Facilitates a detailed, step-by-step thinking process for problem-solving and analysis.”.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: @modelcontextprotocol/server ^2.3.1. Lower-bound version 2.3.1 of @modelcontextprotocol/server (npm) was published on 2026-10-05, within the 12 months before 2026-11-14.
